title: The Night Bakery
tagline: It's the only game where you decide who gets the last loaf.
how_to_play: Click a choice, or press 1 to 4.

endings.title: A warm street
endings.text: Word gets around. The next morning there's a queue down the street, and someone has fixed the oven while you slept.

endings.title: The honest baker
endings.text: Mr Pike grumbles, but he gives you another week. Mira says she's never been prouder of a broken oven.

endings.title: Closed early
endings.text: You lock up before the sun is fully up. The street is quiet. The last loaf cools on the counter.
